notes.title: Our Summer Sale Ends Soon!
notes.content:
This is the last time to purchase Oblivious Garden for 50% OFF, get it before it is too late!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/323490

And, a new patch for Oblivious Garden has been released. Here are the change notes: 

1. Fixed some translation mistakes.

2. Updated some files for the upcoming Japanese support.

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Oblivious Garden Patch Notes: 28th Jan, 2016
notes.content:
A new patch for Oblivious Garden has been released. Here are the change notes: 

1. Fixed some mistakes in the main route which was reported by our community.

2. Fixed a crash in the White Day add-on. 

Thanks for your support.
